_source: cad/HelmetScan.3dm — LiDAR interior capture, 98003 verts / 181944 faces
_note: Measured interior surface of the reference helmet, in NeurOne body axes. Replaces the ellipsoid as the geometry basis for socket coordinates. PROVISIONAL: a consumer-LiDAR scan of a REFERENCE helmet, not NeurOne CAD. Supersede with exact CAD when it exists (NP-HEX-ZM-001 REG-1).
_frameNote: Aircraft body axes: +x forward (face), +y right, +z down (neck). Origin = centre of the rim plane, on the bowl axis. Front/back fixed by principal direction 2026-07-31: the BACK is the end of the fore-aft axis closest to the scan's +y. The fore-aft axis sits 5.7 deg off horizontal, agreeing with the 5.1 deg tilt in NP-HEX-ZM-001 3.4.

sampling.convention: azimuth 0 = forward, +90 = right; elevation 0 = rim plane, 90 = crown
